learning_objective: 🎯 Let's discover the natural music hiding in the world around us and learn how to draw the beautiful sounds we hear!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: If we close our eyes and listen, the world is full of music! The wind blowing through trees, birds chirping, and rain tapping on the roof all create a beautiful natural soundscape.
Did you know we can draw sounds? We can use soft wavy lines to show a quiet, gentle breeze, and sharp zigzag lines for a loud thunderclap.
For thousands of years, people have made traditional music inspired by their villages. Folk artists often paint the beautiful local birds and animals that inspire their songs.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Draw the Sounds of the Park!
fun_activity.instructions: Sit by a window or in a park with your eyes closed for two minutes. Then, grab your crayons and draw splashy colors and shapes to show what those sounds felt like!

quick_recap: ⭐ Nature creates its own music with wind, water, and animal sounds.
⭐ We can use lines, shapes, and colors to show how different noises feel.
⭐ Traditional folk art is deeply inspired by local sounds and village life.
